description: x402-perp-funding-radar: Cross-venue funding radar: one perpetual's funding on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Bybit and Binance, normalised to one hourly basis and annualised, with mark price and open interest, the cheapest venue to be long and the richest to be short. Params: asset (BTC, ETH), limit=1..200 top rows (default 25), minAnnualSpreadPct drops rows below that spread, historyDays=0..30 adds per-venue history plus deviation alerts, alertAnnualPct sets the alert threshold in annualised % (default 100).
name: x402-perp-funding-radar
